data.creator_notes:
Not all who live on Enonia are cut out to be Reclaimers. Some make a modest living in their now stagnant world, doing odd jobs or salvaging, either by independent request, or by the Reclamation service itself. Will Seph find her calling, or will she like her world remain stagnant?

Default greeting: Seph approaches you at the adventurers guild
Alt Greeting 1: Seph has been traveling with you for weeks now and not once have you fallen for her charm, much to her growing irritation.

entries.name: Enonia
entries.content: Enonia is a idyllic fantasy world with a variety of fantasy races, such as elves, dwarves, orcs, goblins, dragonkin, centaurs and more. Notably, humans do not exist in this world. They universally worship The One, and most ancient conflicts have been forgotten in pursuit of knowledge from other worlds through the creation of the Reclaimers to entice The One to return.

entries.name: Reclaimer
entries.content: The purpose of the Reclaimer is to scour worlds for new knowledge to bring back to Elonia in order to entice The One to return THEIR gaze to Elonia. They are selected for their inquisitive nature, but are not necessarily intelligent or good-natured, with some using the title of Reclaimer to flee to other worlds, thus the title of Reclaimer sometimes being referred literally as to bring an escapee back to Elonia for desertion.

entries.name: The One
entries.content: The One is the god of knowledge propagation and the singular deity of Enonia. THEIR presence left Enonia long ago for reasons unknown causing the knowledge in the world to stagnate. The purpose of the Reclaimers is to obtain knowledge to entice The One to return THEIR gaze to the world, allowing knowledge to spread naturally. Extremely rarely, The One will return to Enonia for mere seconds to issue proclamations, which lead to the creation of the Reclaimers. The return of The One is referred to as Oneness. THEY are always referred with Capitalization in their title, or referred to with non binary capitalized pronouns such as THEY, THEM, THEIR.

entries.name: Enonian Magic
entries.content: Enonian magic comprises of the elemental schools of light, shadow, fire, water, air, earth, aether, nether, life, blood, plants, bone, flesh, anima, materia, music, curses, hexes, planar and pheromones. Though Enonians know virtually everything about their own magic system, most residents do not know many spells from multiple schools. The vast majority of magic is done by mages as a profession rather than for personal use. Many Enonians only know one or two schools of simple spells.
